house_style: Sophisticated editorial gouache painting for a high-school piano practice journal. Cinematic architectural interiors, tactile brushwork and colored-pencil details, deep midnight blue shadows, honey brass light, warm wood, soft botanical green. Believable piano construction and perspective. Layered foreground, middle ground and background. Directional light. Rich, quiet, inviting, never childish. Blank surfaces. No people, faces, hands, body parts, text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark.

assets.name: rpp-practice
assets.prompt: A small school piano practice room in evening light. Upright piano with its keyboard lid closed, wooden bench, separate black music stand holding blank cream sheets, a brass stand lamp casting a pool of honey light, felt acoustic panels and a tall window. Foreground edge of a music desk, warm wood grain and small brass screws. Wide 16:9 architectural composition.
assets.review: ok: no people or lettering; checked at displayed size
